title: 彭博智库：AI大模型盈利困局，中国科技巨头如何破局？
speaker: Robert Lee

segments.en: And that is a utility service. And I spoke yesterday comparing China's AI sector, which is populated by 988 large language models.
segments.zh: 这是一种公用事业服务。我昨天谈到，中国AI领域有988个大语言模型。

segments.en: The proof models approved by the regulator, it's flooded with supply, so the parallels with the solar industry are stark. It's a commoditized sector.
segments.zh: 监管机构批准的模型数量众多，供给过剩，与光伏行业有相似之处。这是一个同质化严重的领域。

segments.en: It's hard to gain a sustainable competitive edge, therefore hard to monetize. So ultimately, it's not just me, but investors, showing me the money. How are you going to make money out of these things?
segments.zh: 难以获得可持续的竞争优势，因此难以变现。最终，不仅是投资者，都在问：如何从中赚钱？

segments.en: And we've been asking, posing that question for best part of three years now. What about the same question to US models, for example, where the economics might, but part of the economics might be different, but the commercial undertone is the same.
segments.zh: 这个问题我们已经问了近三年。美国模型的情况可能有所不同，但商业本质是一样的。

segments.en: You still need to make money, but you're also getting a ton of catbecks in there. Well, that's true, because if I came in here and said, right, I've bought a new $5 million apartment.
segments.zh: 你仍然需要赚钱，但你也投入了大量资本开支。确实如此，就像如果我在这里说，我买了一套500万美元的新公寓。

segments.en: Look at me, this is brilliant on the peak, where you probably wouldn't get one on the peak. But anyway, if I'm not telling you, but if I'm not disclosing my $5 million or whatever, my mortgage, then you're only getting half the story.
segments.zh: 看看我，这很棒，但你可能不会在高峰期买。但如果我不告诉你我的抵押贷款，你只看到了故事的一半。

segments.en: So similarly, regardless of who they are, companies, and I think it's been far too focused within the market in China and even maybe the US on top line revenue growth, which is important, but you've got to look at the whole picture.
segments.zh: 同样，无论哪家公司，市场都过于关注营收增长，这固然重要，但必须看整体。

segments.en: So again, not picking on Alibaba, the operating profit or adjusted eBay in their cloud business increased by just over 500 million US dollars last year. So that's the increasing profit over 12 months.
segments.zh: 再以阿里巴巴为例，其云业务调整后利润去年增加了5亿多美元。这是12个月内的利润增长。

segments.en: However, over the last three years, their catbecks has quadrupled to about 18 or 19 billion. So when you look at the financials for Alibaba, you've got to look at the net picture.
segments.zh: 然而，过去三年，其资本开支翻了两番，达到约180-190亿美元。所以看阿里巴巴的财务，必须看净额。

segments.en: So when you net everything off, they're in a hole. They're losing money as is every Chinese company.
segments.zh: 所以净额计算后，他们处于亏损状态。和中国许多公司一样。
